title: Lake Hopatcong Cruises

services.name: Lunch Cruise
services.desc: Lake Hopatcong Cruises invites you to host your private event aboard Miss Lotta and experience the lake in a whole new way. Enjoy 360° lake views, fresh air, and the natural beauty of Lake Hopatcong as your group cruises the water together. Make your next celebration or gathering truly memorable with a refreshing alternative to the typical landlocked event space. All prices, packages and menus are from 2026 and are subject to change from year to year. Check with our Event Coordinator for availability. A signed contract and a non-refundable/ non-transferable deposit of $500 is required in order to hold your date. Transform the inside of our vessel to appeal to your special event! From

blurb: Lake Hopatcong Cruises offers a variety of experiences on the lake including lively brunches, sunset dinners, cocktail cruises, and themed events. Guests enjoy conversation, laughter, and scenic views aboard the Miss Lotta. The cruises are suitable for families, friends, co-workers, and special occasions.
